microarray.readouts: gene expression profiles, differentially expressed genes, blood transcription module activity

evidence_location.quote: BTMs related to the induction of interferons as well as the activation of dendritic cells were enriched on days 1 and 3 after TIV vaccination, whereas modules related to T cells at these time points were negatively associated with the antibody response.

hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibo.readouts: influenza strain-specific antibody titers, fold-change antibody response at day 28 and day 180, seroconversion/persistence classification

evidence_location.quote: In the 2010 and 2011 seasons, in which elderly subjects were included, antibody responses showed a significant decrease with age.

Flow Cytometry Analysis.readouts: NK cell frequencies, NK subset frequencies, monocyte subset frequencies, CD69 geometric mean fluorescence intensity, CCR5 expression, CD86 expression

evidence_location.quote: Our analysis showed that proportions of total NK cells in elderly subjects were higher than those of young subjects at baseline as well as at all the time points studied (days 0–14).

miRNA expression profiling.readouts: expression levels of 672 human miRNAs, differentially expressed miRNAs, miRNAs correlated with HAI response

evidence_location.quote: We saw a significant difference in the miRNA profiles between these two groups.
